name: Starlight Charm
css:
/* Starlight Charm: an original magical girl drifting through a pastel dusk sky (original illustration, no existing character). The art shifts with the window so her face always sits in the free strip right of the conversation; her wand sparkles while the agent works, and a ribbon over the composer fills as the context does. Light only. */
 :root{--t3-radius-composer: 22px;--t3-radius-bubble: 20px;--t3-radius-card: 16px;--t3-radius-control: 10px;--t3-composer-outline: rgb(160 120 220 / 0.45);--t3-composer-shadow: none;--sc-violet: #8a5cd6;--sc-pink: #f07cb4;--sc-gold: #e8b64c;--sc-ink: #3b2a5c;--sc-script: "Snell Roundhand","Savoye LET","Apple Chancery",cursive;--sc-cx: calc(75vw + 248px);--sc-iw: max(177.78vh,calc(var(--sc-cx) / 0.75));--sc-ih: calc(var(--sc-iw) * 0.5625);--sc-x: calc(var(--sc-cx) - 0.75 * var(--sc-iw))}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]{isolation: isolate;accent-color: var(--sc-violet);background: var(--t3-asset-art) var(--sc-x) 30px / var(--sc-iw) auto no-repeat,linear-gradient(180deg,#b9a5e6,#d8b8e6 30%,#f3c6c6)}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]::after{content: "";position: fixed;z-index: -1;left: calc(var(--sc-x) + 0.641 * var(--sc-iw) - 60px);top: calc(30px + 0.142 * var(--sc-ih) - 60px);width: 120px;height: 120px;background: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 47%,#fff 50%,transparent 53%) center / 100% 6px no-repeat,linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 47%,#fff 50%,transparent 53%) center / 6px 100% no-repeat,radial-gradient(closest-side,#fff,rgb(255 230 160 / 0.7) 30%,transparent);mix-blend-mode: screen;opacity: 0;pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="main"]{--app-theme-canvas: transparent}[data-t3-part="sidebar"]{--app-theme-sidebar: transparent;background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(248 242 255 / 0.78),rgb(255 240 246 / 0.82));backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.2);border-right: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7)}.sidebar-stage-backdrop{display: none}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span{color: var(--sc-violet)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span>span{font: 700 25px/1 var(--sc-script);color: var(--sc-ink)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span::after{content: "\2726";margin-left: 6px;color: var(--sc-gold);font-size: 14px}[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"]{background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85);box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(160 120 220 / 0.3),0 2px 8px -4px rgb(120 80 200 / 0.4)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-toolbar"] button{color: var(--sc-violet)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]{background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.82);box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(160 120 220 / 0.22),0 6px 16px -10px rgb(110 70 190 / 0.5)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]:hover{background: #fff}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-variant="card"] [data-t3-part="thread-body"]{height: auto;padding-block: 10px}[data-t3-part="thread-title"]{white-space: normal;overflow: visible;text-overflow: clip;font: 600 14.5px/1.3 "Avenir Next",system-ui,sans-serif;color: var(--sc-ink)}[data-t3-part="project-name"]{color: var(--sc-pink);font-weight: 700}[data-t3-part="thread-status"],[data-t3-part="thread-meta"]{color: #8c7aa8}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][aria-current="page"]{background: linear-gradient(135deg,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.95),rgb(246 230 255 / 0.95));box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--sc-violet),inset 0 0 0 4px rgb(240 124 180 / 0.25),0 6px 10px -8px rgb(138 92 214 / 0.8)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="working"]{box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--sc-pink),inset 0 0 14px -2px rgb(240 124 180 / 0.8)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="waiting"]{outline: 1.5px dashed var(--sc-gold);outline-offset: -4px}[data-t3-part="sidebar-section-header"]{color: var(--sc-violet);font-weight: 700;letter-spacing: 0.1em;text-transform: uppercase;font-size: 11px}[data-t3-part="chat-header"]{background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(250 244 255 / 0.85),rgb(250 244 255 / 0.6));backdrop-filter: blur(12px);border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7)}[data-t3-part="chat-header"] nav li:last-child h2 span{font: 700 22px/1.2 var(--sc-script);color: var(--sc-ink)}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"]{background: linear-gradient(135deg,#9b6ee0,#e27bb8);color: #fff;border: 0;box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -10px rgb(138 92 214 / 0.8),inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35)}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"] *{color: inherit}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"]:has(.chat-markdown){background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.88);border-radius: var(--t3-radius-card);padding: 18px 22px 10px;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(160 120 220 / 0.25),0 18px 40px -18px rgb(90 50 160 / 0.55);color: var(--sc-ink)}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"] :not(pre)>code{background: #f3eaff;border-color: #dcc8f7;color: #6a3fb8}[data-t3-part="code-block"]{box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #e4d6f8}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]{position: relative;background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.92);box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35)}[data-t3-part="composer"]{filter: drop-shadow(0 14px 18px rgb(90 50 160 / 0.3))}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]::before{content: "";position: absolute;z-index: 21;left: 28px;right: 28px;top: 0;height: 3px;border-radius: 3px;background: linear-gradient(90deg,var(--sc-gold),var(--sc-pink),var(--sc-violet));transform-origin: left;transform: scaleX(var(--t3-context-used,0));pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="composer-context"]{background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75)}[data-t3-part="composer-toolbar"] button[aria-label="Submit message"]{background: linear-gradient(135deg,var(--sc-gold),var(--sc-pink) 55%,var(--sc-violet));color: #fff;box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -4px rgb(240 124 180 / 0.9)}[data-t3-part="chat"][data-t3-agent="working"] [data-t3-part="composer-surface"]{box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(240 124 180 / 0.25)}[data-t3-part="chat"][data-t3-agent="working"] [data-t3-part="composer"]{filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgb(240 124 180 / 0.6))}[data-t3-part="sidebar-content"],[data-t3-part="transcript"]{scrollbar-color: #c9b2ee transparent}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){[data-t3-part="app-shell"]::after{animation: sc-twinkle 2.6s ease-in-out 3}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]:has([data-t3-part="chat"][data-t3-agent="working"])::after{animation: sc-twinkle 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}}@keyframes sc-twinkle{0%,100%{opacity: 0;transform: scale(0.5) rotate(0deg)}50%{opacity: 0.95;transform: scale(1) rotate(45deg)}}
